column2: Your courtiers also suffer the effects of the current level of food
All Grace is forfeit and all Chinese Princesses lose their special standing.
All relevant female relatives of the new Emperor of China gains the Chinese Princess status.
All male line ancestors not already part of the Imperial Family rejoin it.
All non-bastard male line descendants not explicitly given a surname rejoin the Imperial Family.
You will regain some of your lost youth.
Gains a titular empire title and becomes a Chinese Imperial pretender
The current holder of the Chrysanthemum Throne abdicates to the eligible member of the Imperial Family most liked by the victor
